description: Enjoy everyone’s favorite classic arcade game, PAC-MAN, for FREE! PAC-MAN is the retro arcade game you know and love, but bigger and better than ever before! Join millions of fans worldwide and compete in Tournaments, experience new Mazes, earn Achievements, and win bragging rights at the top of the Leaderboards! The player controls character through a maze, eating dots (also called biscuits or just dots). When all dots are eaten, player is taken to the next stage. Enjoy Pac-Man Championship for FREE!
